scene.note: On a narrow screen the phone layout's rules join the cascade, but they still have to win against every other rule for the same element.

steps.note: Bartek's phone is narrower than 640px, so the phone layout's condition is true and its rules join in.
The phone rule for the film grid now competes with every other rule that sets the grid's columns, with no extra strength for being in a media query.
Whichever rule wins decides the columns. A rule outside the query can win on a phone too.
When the phone rule is the one that wins on a phone, the films sit one above the other.
On the same phone the phone layout also stacks the footer's three parts.
Another rule sets how the footer's parts sit, and here the rules are not equally strong.
When the phone rule wins here too, the footer's parts sit one above the other on a phone.

value.label: wider than 640px
values: membership and gifts in two columns

steps.note: Above the phone layout's width, the page keeps the layout it had.
A fix that sets one column outside the media query, or moves its condition, reaches these screens too.
With the fix only inside the phone layout, phones get one column and wider screens keep three.
